theory.heading: What Correlation vs Causation is
theory.body: Correlation vs Causation describes the methods and patterns used within Data Science to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.
points: Correlation vs Causation is a named, repeatable concept.
It has a clear purpose and scope.
It connects to other course topics.

theory.heading: Why Correlation vs Causation matters
theory.body: Without Correlation vs Causation, systems built with Data Science are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How Correlation vs Causation works
theory.body: The mechanism behind Correlation vs Causation follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of Correlation vs Causation.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of Correlation vs Causation
theory.body: Correlation vs Causation offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
